messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Prednisone is a prescription corticosteroid (steroid) used to reduce inflammation, suppress an overactive immune system, and treat endocrine and metabolic disorders. Prednisone is used for a wide range of conditions, including severe allergies, asthma and COPD flare-ups, rheumatoid arthritis and other forms of arthritis, lupus, psoriasis and other skin conditions, ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, eye inflammation, some blood disorders, and low adrenal hormone levels.
Prednisone works by mimicking the effects of glucocorticoid hormones secreted naturally by our adrenal glands. Prednisone is a man-made (synthetic) version of these hormones. Prednisone is different from steroids taken to build muscle (anabolic steroids).
Prednisone belongs to the drug class called glucocorticoids, which are a type of corticosteroid.
Triplet: ["Prednisone", "is different from", "steroids taken to build muscle"]

The relation 'is different from' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug differs from the object entity in its properties or use.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has own approved uses': The subject drug has its own specific approved medical uses that differ from those of the object entity.
B. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
C. 'distinguished from': The subject drug can be differentiated or identified as separate from the substance specified by the object entity.
D. 'compared with': The subject drug is compared to the object entity in clinical trials or studies.
E. 'not effectively removed by': The subject drug is not effectively removed from the body by the method or treatment specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
